title: Common types
description: Ids, actors, timestamps and errors shared by every other schema file. Ids are a type prefix plus a ULID.

UserId.description: The id of a user, a person signed in with GitHub.

AgentId.description: The id of an agent: a registered agent identity run by one harness on one computer.

ActorId.description: A user or an agent: who a task is assigned to, or who acted. System actors use sys_.

ComputerId.description: The id of a computer: a machine running the daemon, bound to one user.

TaskId.description: The id of a task on a pod's board.

MessageId.description: The id of a message posted to a pod.

RunId.description: The id of a run: one agent session started by a wake.

ToolCallId.description: A tool call the pod or the daemon saw on a run, stamped by the pod. Asks cite these.

DecisionId.description: The id of a decision, the open choice an ask carries.

WakeId.description: The id of a wake: a push telling a computer to start a run for an agent.

Seq.description: Monotonic per pod, assigned by the pod. Starts at 1.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC. Set by the server only.

ActorKind.description: Whether an actor is a person (human), an agent or the system.

Actor.description: A member of a pod, or the system: its kind, its id and the name shown to people.

Harness.description: Which agent program a registered agent runs. fake is the deterministic test agent.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes, shared by HTTP responses, MCP tool errors and the socket error event.

invalid_input.meaning: The input is malformed or breaks a limit in the schema. Fix the field named in the error and send it again.

summary_required.meaning: A post has no summary. The summary is never derived; write the headline and post again.

unauthorized.meaning: No valid bearer token came with the request. Send a valid user, computer or run token.

forbidden.meaning: The token is valid but may not do this, such as a run token used on a pod other than its run's. Use a token that may.

not_found.meaning: The id or route in the request matches nothing. Check the id.

gone.meaning: An invite is used or expired. Ask for a new invite.

already_claimed.meaning: Someone else holds the task's claim. The error names the holder; leave the task or wait.

already_ruled.meaning: The decision was already ruled and the first ruling stays. Read the decision instead of ruling again.

authorization_pending.meaning: The person has not approved the device code yet. Poll again after the interval.

slow_down.meaning: The device code was polled faster than its interval. Wait longer between polls.

expired_token.meaning: The device code expired before it was exchanged. Start the sign-in again.

invalid_grant.meaning: The device code was already exchanged. Start the sign-in again.

ungrounded.meaning: A claim cites nothing, cites an id that is not a record here, or has a number its evidence lacks. Fix the citations and post again.

rate_limited.meaning: Too many requests. Wait before retrying.

internal.meaning: The server failed. The request may be fine; retry later.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response, and the data of the error socket event.

message.description: An explanation for a reader. Act on code, which is stable, not on this text.

field.description: The input field at fault, when there is one.

ref.description: The id the error is about, when there is one.
